name: QMAI (青幕AI写作)
description: A memory-based AI writing desktop system for long-form novel creation, targeting 2-3 million word serialized works. Uses structured memory systems and hybrid retrieval engines so AI 'remembers everything' across long works.
features: Memory System with chapter ingestion and context engine
Draft Isolation (AI-generated chapters remain drafts until human confirmation)
De-AI Rewriting (style transformation to reduce templated AI expressions)
Hybrid retrieval engine (keyword + vector + graph search with RRF ranking)
aiCapabilities: LLM-based chapter generation with memory context
Six-dimension review (satisfaction, setting, pacing, character, narrative, engagement)
targetUsers: Web novel daily updaters, novel planners, AI-assisted writers seeking long-form consistency
notes: Very similar architecture to niko-studio (Tauri + React + Rust). Strong focus on memory and consistency for long-form writing. MIT license allows commercial use.

name: StoryCraftr
description: An open-source AI-powered CLI tool that helps writers craft stories, generate worldbuilding details, and create book outlines and chapters seamlessly. Part of the AI Craftr suite.
features: Outline generation (character summaries to chapter synopses)
Chapter generation (auto-generate chapters, cover pages, epilogues)
targetUsers: Novelists, fiction writers, creative writers needing structure and AI assistance
notes: CLI-first tool, not a desktop app. Part of a suite (PaperCraftr also exists). Uses LangChain framework. Beta status.

name: autonovel
description: An autonomous pipeline for writing, revising, typesetting, illustrating, and narrating a complete novel. Transforms a seed concept into print-ready PDF, ePub, audiobook, and landing page.
features: 4-phase pipeline (Foundation → First Draft → Revision + Opus Review → Export)
Two immune systems (mechanical slop detection + LLM judge)
Five co-evolving document layers (voice, world, characters, outline, prose)
aiCapabilities: Anthropic Claude (Sonnet for writing/evaluation, Opus for review)
Adversarial editing and automated revision cycles
Voice fingerprint discovery and adherence checking
targetUsers: Writers, AI researchers, publishers interested in automated long-form fiction production
notes: Research-oriented project from NousResearch. Focus on fully autonomous novel generation. Not a user-facing tool but a pipeline. Inspired by karpathy/autoresearch.

name: Story Architect (Starc)
description: Reinventing the screenwriting software. An advanced text editor for script writers working professionally in film, novel, theatre, radio or writing for comic books.
features: Modules for film, TV, comic books, stage, radio
Research tools (text documents, mind maps, images)
Title pages, movie posters, crew information
Multiple scripts per project for episodic content
targetUsers: Professional screenwriters, playwrights, novelists, comic book writers, radio drama writers
notes: Successor to open-source Kit Scenarist. Professional screenwriting focus, not AI-powered. C++ native desktop app. Premium pricing model available. Beta status.

name: NovelForge
description: 新一代 AI 长篇小说创作引擎. AI-assisted long-form novel writing engine with card-based structured creation, designed for million-word-scale fiction projects.
features: Schema-driven card creation with JSON Schema validation
Streaming field-level AI generation with feedback loops
Chapter word count control (prompt constraint or control mode)
Universal review system with draft preview → confirmation
Code-based workflow system (Python-style DSL) with visual editor
Workflow Agent for natural language workflow creation
license: AGPL-3.0 (default); commercial license required for SaaS/hosting
aiCapabilities: Structured generation with JSON Schema validation
Tool-calling Agent with ReAct mode fallback
Multi-model support with per-card LLM configuration
targetUsers: Novelists creating long-form fiction requiring structural consistency, worldbuilding complexity, and AI-assisted iterative refinement
notes: Chinese-language interface and documentation. Card-based architecture. Dual-licensed AGPL/commercial. Strong workflow system.

name: StoryLine (obsidian-storyline)
description: StoryLine transforms your Obsidian vault into a complete book planning and writing tool. Organize scenes, build characters, manage locations, track plotlines, and monitor progress, all inside Obsidian.
features: Multiple Views (Corkboard, Board/Kanban, Plotgrid, Timeline, Plotlines, Manuscript)
Series mode for multi-book projects with shared Codex hub
Beat sheet templates (Save the Cat, Hero's Journey, etc.)
Setup/payoff tracking and plot hole detection
Export to Markdown, JSON, CSV, HTML, PDF, DOCX
Custom scene fields and color coding
targetUsers: Novelists, book authors, and fiction writers seeking Scrivener-like functionality within Obsidian
notes: Obsidian plugin, not standalone app. No AI features. Strong visual planning tools. Single contributor. Very active maintenance.

name: Longform
description: A plugin for Obsidian that helps you write and edit novels, screenplays, and other long projects. Organizes scenes into ordered manuscripts.
features: Dedicated sidebar collecting projects across vault
Workflow-based compilation tool for generating manuscripts
targetUsers: Writers of novels, screenplays, and other long projects using Obsidian
notes: Obsidian plugin. Simple and focused on scene organization. Built specifically to never alter note contents. Community compile steps available.

name: Manuskript
description: An open-source tool for writers that helps with creating first drafts and refining manuscripts.
features: Grow premise from sentence → paragraph → full summary
Spell checker, markdown highlighter, frequency analyzer
Auto-save in open and plain text file format
targetUsers: Writers seeking an open-source, cross-platform tool for novel and non-fiction composition
notes: Traditional open-source writing tool. No AI features. Cross-platform (Linux, Mac, Windows). Active translation community. Many open issues (567).

name: novelWriter
description: A plain text editor designed for writing novels assembled from many smaller text documents. Minimal formatting syntax inspired by Markdown with meta data syntax for comments, synopsis, and cross-referencing.
features: Project format suited for version control and file sync
Organizes text and notes across multiple documents
Meta data syntax for comments, synopsis, cross-referencing
targetUsers: Novelists seeking a simple, organized, non-proprietary writing environment
notes: Explicitly '100% free of AI slop'. Contribution guidelines reject AI-generated content. Very mature project with 7663+ commits. Free Windows code signing via SignPath.io.

name: AI-Novel-Writing-Assistant (AI小说创作工作台)
description: AI-native engine for end-to-end novel creation — from idea to full chapters, with structured planning, worldbuilding, and agent-driven workflows. Designed as a production system for long-form fiction.
features: AI Auto-Director (generates complete book directions from inspiration)
Style Engine (extractable, editable, bindable writing style assets)
Worldbuilding & Character Systems (faction maps, location networks, relationship webs)
Chapter Execution (writing, auditing, repair, foreshadowing resolution)
Manga/Comic Workbench (storyboard editing, cross-episode fact checking)
Model Routing (different providers/models for different tasks)
license: AGPL-3.0 (default); commercial license required for SaaS/hosting
aiCapabilities: Agent-driven workflows with Planner, Tool Registry, Runtime
targetUsers: Complete beginners who need help finishing entire novels, not just writing individual passages
notes: Chinese-language project. Monorepo architecture. Targets beginners specifically. Dual-licensed AGPL/commercial. Very active development (33 releases).

name: WeKnora
description: Open-source LLM knowledge platform: turn raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki. Enterprise-focused knowledge management.
features: ReAct Agent (autonomous orchestration of retrieval, MCP tools, web search)
Wiki Mode (self-maintaining markdown knowledge base with interactive graph)
10+ document format support (PDF, Word, images, Excel, PPT, CSV, HTML, Markdown, JSON, TXT)
Multiple vector databases (PostgreSQL/pgvector, Elasticsearch, Milvus, etc.)
IM channel integrations (WeCom, Feishu, Slack, Telegram, etc.)
Web search integrations (DuckDuckGo, Bing, Google, etc.)
targetUsers: Enterprise teams requiring document-to-knowledge automation, AI-powered internal search, self-hosted private LLM infrastructure
notes: Enterprise knowledge platform, not a writing tool per se. But has strong RAG, agent, and wiki capabilities that could be adapted. Very large community (16.4k stars). Tencent-backed. Strong Chinese ecosystem integration.

name: Marginalia
description: A library-science-inspired personal knowledge management system with LLM agents. Turns PDFs, notes, spreadsheets, logs, and archives into a private AI library that answers from original sources.
features: Ingests diverse formats (text, Markdown, PDFs, DOCX, images, spreadsheets, logs, archives)
Hybrid retrieval (lexical search + optional embeddings + sqlite-vec + reranking)
Agent reads original sections before answering
Deep mode for full ReAct investigation loop
Durable investigation notes for future recall
aiCapabilities: Configurable models for chat, reflection, ingest, vision
Vision profile for image enrichment, PDF figure captioning, scanned-PDF OCR
ReAct workflow favored over one-shot RAG
Relation discovery with lazy vetting and graph-based neighbors
targetUsers: Researchers and knowledge workers with messy private knowledge bases who want answers that cite source material
notes: PKM tool, not a writing tool. But has strong retrieval and agent capabilities. Tauri-based desktop app. Very early stage (56 stars). AGPL license.
